coupling: The fixed-rank validation commit safely extends the compressed rank-N slab reader to eleven dimensions and defines MATIO_SLAB_RANK_LIMIT for its scratch arrays and guard. The later integer-overflow refactor uses that shared limit for the uncompressed rank-N guard, while its inc, dimp, and cnt arrays still have ten entries. Thus a valid rank-eleven uncompressed MAT5 slab passes validation and writes beyond inc[10]. A correct repair must carry the earlier supported-rank change through the later refactor by sizing every uncompressed scratch array for the same limit; changing only the compressed reader or the widened arithmetic leaves the mismatch.
